speaker: Delroy
text: "Need a grey German saloon, E-plates, no scratches. Bring it me clean and there's a bag in it."

on_fail.text: Alarm went. You left it steaming on the ramp.

speaker: The Brief
text: "Put me on retainer. Next time they nick you, I'll have you out before the tea's cold."

speaker: A fiend
text: "Sort me out till Friday, yeah? I'm good for it. You know I'm good for it."

speaker: An Older
text: "You're moving too loud, yout. Slow down, stack quiet, and the feds forget your face."

effects.text: You lie low a beat. Heat drops.

speaker: A face you know
text: "Feds been asking about the docks crew. They'll pay for names. Nobody'd know it was you."

effects.text: You walk. Some lines you don't cross.

win.text: Envelope, no questions. Sick to your stomach.

lose.text: Word got out you talked. Now everyone's watching.

speaker: Bossman
text: "You leave my shop alone, I'll let you shot outside. Fair's fair, innit?"

effects.text: Corner's yours. He looks the other way.

win.text: Till and all. He won't offer again.

lose.text: He had a bat under the counter.

speaker: A car-crew lad
text: "Big meet tonight, whole ring's out. Bring a dinger and there's serious paper — if it's clean."

on_pass.text: They rated the motor. Big night.

on_fail.text: Plod rolled the meet. You bounced empty.

speaker: A docker
text: "Container 47's got no seal and no eyes on it till six. What's inside, who knows. You want the nod?"

effects.text: Too good to be true, usually is.

speaker: The gym coach
text: "Spar a round? Won't cost you but a bit of puff. Keeps you sharp for the road."

speaker: Some youngers
text: "We'll watch the block for you, big man. Whistle if feds come. Small cut, that's all."

effects.text: Eyes everywhere now. Worth the forty.

speaker: Keisha
text: "Someone tried to sell me your gear. Told 'em to do one. You owe me one, though."

effects.text: "Now we're square." Good to have her onside.

speaker: The night
text: Power's out across three blocks. No cameras, no lights. The whole ends is holding its breath.

on_pass.text: Cleaned up in the dark. Gone before the lights.

on_fail.text: Tripped over your own feet in the black.

speaker: Mum
text: "I don't want to know what you're doing out there. Just... be careful. Come for dinner Sunday."

effects.text: You lie low for her. Head's clearer for it.

speaker: A wasteman
text: "Oi, you think you're Top Boy or suttin? This my corner now." He's shaking as he says it.

on_pass.text: He was gone before you finished the sentence.

on_fail.text: He got a lucky one in and legged it. Embarrassing.

effects.text: Not worth the graze. You move on.

speaker: A bent fed
text: "I can lose your file. Make the heat disappear. But it'll cost you, and this conversation never happened."

effects.text: File's gone. You were never a person of interest.
You walk. Could be a setup.

speaker: A tip-off
text: Word is a rival left a stash in an empty flat, unguarded. Could be a jackpot. Could be bait.

on_fail.text: Bait. They were waiting. You barely got out.

speaker: The Plug
text: "You've got the numbers now. Want a line out to the cunch? Steady money if you keep it fed."

effects.text: "Soon. When you're Grafter, come see me." (Trapline — level 25.)

speaker: A gambler
text: "Double or nothing on the dogs. I've got a sure thing. You in?"

speaker: A neighbour
text: "I saw what you did. I've not called anyone... yet. Be a shame if I had to."

on_pass.text: They looked away first. Curtains shut.

on_fail.text: They called it in the second you left.

speaker: An enforcer
text: "You owe the man upstairs. He sent me to remind you. Nicely, this time."

win.text: He respects the neck. "I'll pass it on."

speaker: Some kids
text: The little ones off the block want you in for a game on the cage. For a minute you're not on road.

effects.text: You forgot to be hard for ten minutes. Needed that.

speaker: A fraudster
text: "Pallet of fakes going cheap. Retail 'em right and it's triple. Sketchy batch though — buyer beware."

win.text: Moved every last one. Triple, easy.

lose.text: Stitching gave it away. Ate the loss.

speaker: A moped kid
text: "Lend us your bike for a run? I'll cut you in. Quick ting, in and out."

win.text: Back in ten with your cut. Sound kid.

lose.text: He got chased and dumped your bike. Cheers.

effects.text: He sucks his teeth and goes.

speaker: A jeweller
text: "That watch you brought — it's peng. I've a buyer who pays top. Or I can trade you something certi."

on_pass.text: You read him right. Big bag.

speaker: The season
text: Snow on the estate, everyone indoors, feds off the street. Quiet — the useful kind of quiet.

effects.text: Froze your fingers off but the roads were yours.

speaker: Green Lane Boys
text: "We're sick of beefing you. Straight truce — you don't touch ours, we don't touch yours. Deal?"

speaker: A wannabe
text: "Let me film you for the 'gram, fam. You'll blow up. Everyone'll know the name."

effects.text: Camera in your face is a witness statement waiting to happen.

win.text: Went viral. The right people noticed.

lose.text: The WRONG people noticed. It's evidence now.

speaker: A lost tourist
text: Map out, bag open, Rolex on, asking YOU for directions. Bless.

options.label: Point them wrong and dip the bag

on_pass.text: Watch, wallet, and a wave goodbye.

on_fail.text: They felt the hand. Screamed the street down.

speaker: An old friend
text: "I got out the game, bruv. Straight job, kids, the lot. You could too, you know. There's still time."

effects.text: You think about it the whole way home.

speaker: Unknown number
text: The burner rings. Nobody has this number. "We know what you did on the docks. Meet, or we talk to the feds."

on_pass.text: Bluff. You called it and they folded.

on_fail.text: Shakedown. They took a cut to stay quiet.

speaker: The Plug
text: "Once-in-a-year drop. Buy big now, sell all season. But it's every P you've got up front."

win.text: Best move you ever made. Bagged all winter.

lose.text: Drop got hit. You're back to zero.

speaker: A nurse
text: "You keep ending up in here. One day it won't be stitches, love. Look after yourself."

effects.text: You rest up proper. Back stronger.

speaker: The word on road
text: They're saying you might be the biggest thing this city's seen since the old Top Boy. Big shoes. Bigger targets.

effects.text: You feel the whole map shift under you.
